description: [DeepViewAgg](https://drprojects.github.io/deepviewagg-site) was accepted for an oral at CVPR’22
[SuperCluster](https://drprojects.github.io/supercluster-site) was accepted for an oral at 3DV’24

PhD defense at [IGN](https://www.ign.fr) in presence of [Cédric Demonceaux](https://sites.google.com/view/cedricdemonceaux/home), [Sébastien Lefèvre](https://people.irisa.fr/Sebastien.Lefevre/), [Patrick Pérez](https://ptrckprz.github.io/), [Siyu Tang](https://vlg.inf.ethz.ch/team/Prof-Dr-Siyu-Tang.html), [Duygu Ceylan](https://www.duygu-ceylan.com/), [Loïc Landrieu](https://loiclandrieu.com/), and [Bruno Vallet](https://www.umr-lastig.fr/bruno-vallet/)
Joined the [EcoVision](https://dm3l.uzh.ch/en/wegner) lab at [University of Zurich](https://www.uzh.ch/en.html) as a postdoctoral researcher
Gave a workshop tutorial on [Superpoint Transformer](https://drprojects.github.io/superpoint-transformer-site) hosted by [Florent Poux](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2qKhpQs9gJw)
[Loic Landrieu](https://loiclandrieu.com/) visit to [EcoVision](https://dm3l.uzh.ch/en/wegner) and [ETH AI Center](https://ai.ethz.ch/)

[Emilia Arens](https://dm3l.uzh.ch/workgroup/wegner/team) and [Johannes Dollinger](https://dm3l.uzh.ch/workgroup/wegner/team) will present our research on _Deep Species Distribution Modeling_ at the [LPS'25](https://lps25.esa.int/)
I will serve as Area Chair for [ECCV'26](https://eccv.ecva.net/Conferences/2026)
Released [torch-graph-components](https://github.com/drprojects/torch-graph-components), which isolates the core graph algorithms from [EZ-SP](https://louisgeist.github.io/ez-sp)
2 of our works were accepted for oral presentations at the [WBF'26](https://worldbiodiversityforum.org)
[LitePT](https://litept.github.io) was accepted for a highlight at CVPR'26
